n2637079e0b.headline: Oil posts 8% weekly loss on potential Opec+ supply additions
n2637079e0b.summary: Oil prices settled higher on Friday but still posted a weekly loss of 8.1 per cent after reports of potential increases to Opec+ supply. The report is datelined Houston.
n2637079e0b.why: Opec+ is a group of oil producers whose output decisions shape global crude prices, which feed into fuel costs, inflation and energy-company earnings.
n2637079e0b.why_moved: Reports of possible Opec+ supply increases raised expectations of more crude on the market, pushing prices lower over the week.

na91dea850a.headline: Cancer Research UK to close nearly 200 shops in major blow
na91dea850a.summary: Cancer Research UK will close 90 stores by May 2026 and up to 100 more by April 2027. The charity's retail network is one of the largest charity shop operations in the UK.
na91dea850a.why: Cancer Research UK is a major UK charity whose retail shops raise funds for its research, so store closures affect its income.

n8769744949.headline: Europe midday: Stoxx 600 hits another record as banking stocks rise
n8769744949.summary: European stocks pushed further into record territory on Friday, with the Stoxx 600 extending its winning streak to six days. Banking stocks rose despite mostly weaker-than-expected economic data.
n8769744949.why: The Stoxx 600 is a benchmark index covering large and mid-cap companies across Europe, widely used to track the region's equity market.
n8769744949.why_moved: Banking stocks rose, extending a six-day winning streak for the index despite mostly weaker-than-expected economic data.

n5898b04d54.summary: Gold prices soared past the $4,000 mark, reaching record highs. The article describes what is driving the rush into the metal.
n5898b04d54.why: Gold is a traditional store of value and a safe-haven asset that investors buy during uncertainty and currency stress. Its price is also a benchmark for precious metals markets.

ndec68ef817.why: Asahi Group is one of Japan's largest brewers, so a cyber-driven halt to production and distribution affects its earnings and the supply of its beers.

nbffddc9190.headline: Czech Republic: Who is Babis, the man who hopes to be PM?

nbffddc9190.why: Andrej Babis is a billionaire industrialist whose conglomerate Agrofert is one of Czechia's largest companies, and his policies affect the country's fiscal and business environment.
